cases.name: Charline Rosemond
cases.about:
Charline's family opened up about her death recently on WCVB’s CityLine. "The life of the party. She was always brave, very adventurous, and so I always wanted to be like her. She had plans to open up a hair salon," her sister, Rosalie Rosemond, said.

“Charline Rosemond was a promising and hard-working young woman with her whole life ahead of her,” said District Attorney Marian Ryan.
cases.narrative: On 4/13/2009, her body was found slumped in her father’s car in a parking lot in Somerville, MA. Prosecutors allege Anacreon and a friend lured Charline there to buy a car, robbing her of $4,100 and fatally shooting her.
